children: Magnachip Semiconductor entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement for a $5.0 million private placement with Navitas. The company will issue 1,461,988 shares of common stock at $3.42 per share, with closing expected on or about Sep 24, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Magnachip will file an S-3 registration for resale within 30 days of closing and seek effectiveness within 60 to 90 days.
: Stock Purchase Agreement for private placement of common stock
